# Memory-Based Detection of Golden Ticket & SIDHistory Abuse in Active Directory
**MTech Capstone — Microsoft Sentinel Hybrid Detection Framework**

Domain: `corp.local`  |  Domain Controller: `WIN-09GD99A8DPG`  |  Three detection paths: **Kerberos Logs**, **SIDHistory Inventory**, **LSASS Memory Forensics (pypykatz)**

---

content.query: union (SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | where Title has 'Golden Ticket' | summarize Value=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend Metric='Golden Ticket', Ord=1),(SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | where Title has 'SIDHistory' | summarize Value=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend Metric='SIDHistory Abuse', Ord=2),(VolatilityAnalysis_CL | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | where riskLevel_s=='CRITICAL' | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric='Memory CRITICAL (pypykatz)', Ord=3),(SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | summarize Value=dcount(IncidentNumber) | extend Metric='Total Incidents', Ord=4) | order by Ord asc | project Metric, Value
content.title: Detection Summary — last 7 days

content.query: SecurityEvent | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where EventID in (4768,4769,4672,4624,4625,4662) | extend EventName=case(EventID==4768,'4768 TGT Request',EventID==4769,'4769 TGS Request',EventID==4672,'4672 Special Privileges',EventID==4624,'4624 Logon',EventID==4625,'4625 Failed Logon',EventID==4662,'4662 DS Access',tostring(EventID)) | summarize Count=count() by EventName | order by Count desc
content.title: Kerberos Security Events by Type (24h)

content.query: SecurityEvent | where TimeGenerated>ago(24h) | where EventID in (4768,4769,4672) | extend Ev=case(EventID==4768,'TGT (4768)',EventID==4769,'TGS (4769)',EventID==4672,'PrivUse (4672)',tostring(EventID)) | summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,30m), Ev
content.title: Kerberos Activity Timeline (24h)

content.query: SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | extend DetectionType=case(Title has 'Golden Ticket','Golden Ticket (Log)',Title has 'SIDHistory','SIDHistory Abuse',Title has 'Volatility','Memory Forensics (pypykatz)','Other') | where DetectionType!='Other' | summarize Incidents=dcount(IncidentNumber) by DetectionType
content.title: Incidents by Detection Path (7d)

content.query: SIDHistoryInventory_CL | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) and RiskLevel_s=='HIGH' | project TimeGenerated, Account=ObjectName_s, SIDHistory=SIDHistoryEntry_s, Risk=RiskLevel_s | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 10
content.title: SIDHistory — HIGH-risk privileged SIDs

content.json:
## Novel Contribution - Memory-Based Golden Ticket Detection (pypykatz)
LSASS memory dumps are analysed offline. A **TGT (krbtgt) for a user account resident in the Domain Controller's memory** is the signature of an injected Pass-the-Ticket **Golden Ticket**. Standard **Volatility 3 cannot extract Kerberos tickets** on modern Windows - this framework uses **pypykatz**, which does. This is the detection that log-only tools miss. (MITRE **T1558.001**)

content.query: VolatilityAnalysis_CL | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) and riskLevel_s=='CRITICAL' | extend Detail=tostring(parse_json(kerberosAnalysis_indicators_s)[0].description) | extend TargetAccount=tostring(extract(@'account\(s\) \[([^\]]+)\]',1,Detail)) | project TimeGenerated, Risk=riskLevel_s, Indicator=indicator_s, TargetAccount, Tickets=toint(kerberosAnalysis_totalTickets_d), Dump=blobName_s | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 15
content.title: Volatility / pypykatz — CRITICAL memory detections (forged TGT found in LSASS)

content.query: SecurityIncident | where TimeGenerated>ago(7d) | summarize Count=dcount(IncidentNumber) by Status | order by Count desc
content.title: Sentinel Incidents by Status (7d)
